text: Bar height uses the square root of the event count, so one large burst doesn't flatten the rest. A bar twice as tall stands for about four times as many events. Hovering a slice shows its count and time range (e.g. "6 events, 09:35:34 AM to 09:39:34 AM") and darkens the bar, with the whole slice height as the hit area so short bars are easy to target. A small "▮ activity" label beside the axis start time explains the bars on hover. Checked in the browser and committed as 2cf3b68, not pushed. Reload the tab to see it.
